name: AutomationML Edition 2.1 (CAEX 3.0)
description: AutomationML (IEC 62714), published by AutomationML e.V. (https://www.automationml.org), the neutral XML data format for exchanging plant engineering data between engineering tools: the plant's hierarchy of objects, the classes they are instances of, the roles they play, their interfaces and the links between them, and their attributes. Its top-level format is CAEX 3.0 (IEC 62424:2016). Generated from the CAEX 3.0 XML schema (GitHub AutomationML/AMLEngine2.1) and the AutomationML Edition 2.1 base libraries and Part 2 role class libraries (automationml.org): each CAEX element is a node, each of its XML attributes and text elements a property, each element it contains and each path or ID it refers to a relationship, and each standard role class, interface class and attribute type a node whose label the objects of that class carry.

CAEXBasicObject_HAS_REVISION_Revision.description: Organizational information about the state of the revision. Each CAEXBasicObject has zero or more Revision. A composition: each Revision is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

CAEXBasicObject_HAS_SOURCE_OBJECT_INFORM.description: Organizational information about the source of the corresponding CAEX object. Each CAEXBasicObject has zero or more SourceObjectInformation. A composition: each SourceObjectInformation is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

CAEXFile_HAS_SOURCE_DOCUMENT_INFORMATION.description: Provides information about the source(s) of the CAEX document. Each CAEXFile has one or more SourceDocumentInformation. A composition: each SourceDocumentInformation is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

CAEXFile_HAS_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_External.description: Container element for the alias definition of external CAEX files. Each CAEXFile has zero or more ExternalReference. A composition: each ExternalReference is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

Attribute_HAS_REF_SEMANTIC_RefSemantic.description: A reference to a definition of a defined attribute, e. g. to an attribute in a standardized library, this allows the semantic definition of the attribute. Each Attribute has zero or more RefSemantic. A composition: each RefSemantic is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

Attribute_HAS_CONSTRAINT_Constraint.description: Element to restrict the range of validity of a defined attribute. Each Attribute has zero or more Constraint. A composition: each Constraint is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

Attribute_HAS_ATTRIBUTE_Attribute.description: Element that allows the description of nested attributes. Each Attribute has zero or more Attribute. A composition: each Attribute is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

Attribute_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_AttributeType.description: References an attribute type in the attribute library. Resolves the RefAttributeType of the Attribute to the AttributeType it refers to by its path, which may start with an external file's alias and @. Each Attribute has at most one AttributeType.

InternalElement_HAS_ATTRIBUTE_Attribute.description: Characterizes properties of the SystemUnitClass. Each InternalElement has zero or more Attribute. A composition: each Attribute is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

ExternalInterface_HAS_ATTRIBUTE_Attribut.description: Characterizes properties of the InterfaceClass. Each ExternalInterface has zero or more Attribute. A composition: each Attribute is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

ExternalInterface_HAS_EXTERNAL_INTERFACE.description: Each ExternalInterface has zero or more ExternalInterface. A composition: each ExternalInterface is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

ExternalInterface_BASE_CLASS_InterfaceCl.description: Stores the reference of a class to its base class. References contain the full path to the referred class object. Resolves the RefBaseClassPath of the ExternalInterface to the InterfaceClass it refers to by its path, which may start with an external file's alias and @. Each ExternalInterface has at most one InterfaceClass.

ExternalInterface_BASE_CLASS_ExternalInt.description: Stores the reference of a class to its base class. References contain the full path to the referred class object. Resolves the RefBaseClassPath of the ExternalInterface to the ExternalInterface it identifies by its ID: the master object the mirror object repeats. Each ExternalInterface has at most one ExternalInterface.

InternalElement_HAS_EXTERNAL_INTERFACE_E.description: Description of an external interface. Each InternalElement has zero or more ExternalInterface. A composition: each ExternalInterface is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

InternalElement_HAS_INTERNAL_ELEMENT_Int.description: Shall be used in order to define nested objects inside of a SystemUnitClass or another InternalElement. Allows description of the internal structure of a CAEX object. Each InternalElement has zero or more InternalElement. A composition: each InternalElement is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

MappingObject_HAS_ATTRIBUTE_NAME_MAPPING.description: Allows the definition of the mapping between attributes of a related role class or its interfaces and attributes of the hosting system unit. Each MappingObject has zero or more AttributeNameMapping. A composition: each AttributeNameMapping is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

InterfaceIDMapping_SYSTEM_UNIT_INTERFACE.description: Resolves the SystemUnitInterfaceID of the InterfaceIDMapping to the ExternalInterface it identifies by its ID. Each InterfaceIDMapping has exactly one ExternalInterface.

InterfaceIDMapping_ROLE_INTERFACE_Extern.description: Resolves the RoleInterfaceID of the InterfaceIDMapping to the ExternalInterface it identifies by its ID. Each InterfaceIDMapping has exactly one ExternalInterface.

MappingObject_HAS_INTERFACE_ID_MAPPING_I.description: Allows the definition of the mapping between interfaces of a related role class and interfaces of the hosting system unit. Each MappingObject has zero or more InterfaceIDMapping. A composition: each InterfaceIDMapping is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

SupportedRoleClass_HAS_MAPPING_OBJECT_Ma.description: Each SupportedRoleClass has at most one MappingObject. A composition: each MappingObject is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

SupportedRoleClass_ROLE_CLASS_RoleClass.description: Resolves the RefRoleClassPath of the SupportedRoleClass to the RoleClass it refers to by its path, which may start with an external file's alias and @. Each SupportedRoleClass has at most one RoleClass.

InternalElement_HAS_SUPPORTED_ROLE_CLASS.description: Allows the association to a RoleClass which this SystemUnitClass can play. A SystemUnitClass may reference multiple roles. Each InternalElement has zero or more SupportedRoleClass. A composition: each SupportedRoleClass is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

InternalLink_PARTNER_SIDE_A_ExternalInte.description: Resolves the RefPartnerSideA of the InternalLink to the ExternalInterface it identifies by its owner's ID and its name, e.g. `788eb291-…:EnergySupply`. Each InternalLink has exactly one ExternalInterface.

InternalLink_PARTNER_SIDE_B_ExternalInte.description: Resolves the RefPartnerSideB of the InternalLink to the ExternalInterface it identifies by its owner's ID and its name, e.g. `788eb291-…:EnergySupply`. Each InternalLink has exactly one ExternalInterface.

InternalElement_HAS_INTERNAL_LINK_Intern.description: Shall be used in order to define the relationships between internal interfaces of InternalElements. Each InternalElement has zero or more InternalLink. A composition: each InternalLink is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

RoleRequirements_HAS_ATTRIBUTE_Attribute.description: Characterizes properties of the RoleRequirements. Each RoleRequirements has zero or more Attribute. A composition: each Attribute is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

RoleRequirements_HAS_EXTERNAL_INTERFACE_.description: Each RoleRequirements has zero or more ExternalInterface. A composition: each ExternalInterface is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

RoleRequirements_HAS_MAPPING_OBJECT_Mapp.description: Host element for AttributeNameMapping and InterfaceIDMapping. Each RoleRequirements has at most one MappingObject. A composition: each MappingObject is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

InternalElement_HAS_ROLE_REQUIREMENTS_Ro.description: Describes role requirements of an InternalElement. Each InternalElement has zero or more RoleRequirements. A composition: each RoleRequirements is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

InternalElement_BASE_SYSTEM_UNIT_SystemU.description: Stores the reference of an InternalElement to a class or instance definition. References contain the full path information. Each InternalElement has at most one SystemUnitClass.

InternalElement_BASE_SYSTEM_UNIT_Interna.description: Stores the reference of an InternalElement to a class or instance definition. References contain the full path information.
